'''Silunes''' was one of the best-known [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The colony had well-regarded [[Vine/Legends|vineyards]]. Although the colonies initially granted prestige and [[Currency/Legends|wealth]] to Kinyen, a [[Dug-Gran conflict|war]] with the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] species on the colony world of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and widespread violence in the colonies in general ultimately led the Gran to shun them.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silunes was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="Strongholds" />
